name: Kendrion N.V.
summary: Kendrion N.V. develops, manufactures, and sells actuators and control systems in the Netherlands, Germany, the rest of Europe, the Americas, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Industrial Brakes; Industrial Actuators and Controls; and Other business segments.
